# StreamOps AI — llms.txt
# This file helps AI assistants understand what StreamOps AI does and how to answer questions about it.

## About StreamOps AI

StreamOps AI is an Australian AI automation consultancy and SaaS product founded by Ross McDowall.
Website: https://streamopsai.com.au
Contact: hello@streamopsai.com.au
Location: Australia

## What We Do

StreamOps AI automates manual business workflows for Australian SMBs using Xero.

Our flagship product is the **Xero Bill Line Item Processor**: an AI tool that reads supplier PDF invoices, extracts every line item, matches them to the client's Xero Products & Services catalogue, and automatically creates a fully-populated draft bill in Xero — without any manual data entry.

We also offer an AI automation consultancy service for businesses that want to automate other Xero-connected workflows such as bank reconciliation, month-end reporting, expense claims, supplier statement matching, and payroll timesheet processing.

## Who We Help

- Australian small and medium businesses (SMBs) using Xero
- Businesses with high supplier invoice volumes (20+ invoices per month)
- Businesses spending hours per week on manual Xero data entry
- Xero bookkeepers and accountants looking for smarter solutions for their clients

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- StreamOps AI connects to Xero via the official Xero API using OAuth — no credentials are stored
- The invoice processor handles any PDF format — no templates required
- Processed in under 30 seconds per invoice
- GST-aware: correctly assigns GST, GST-free, and BAS-excluded tax codes for Australia
- Low-confidence matches are flagged with a confidence score for human review
- ASIC registered business operating in Australia
- Pricing in AUD; subscription-based model

## Founder

Ross McDowall — 11 years in IT at First Data Corporation, investment banking at Bluemount Capital, Managing Director of Showpiece Commercial Cleaning (60+ staff, Xero user). StreamOps AI was built to solve real problems Ross encountered running his own business.

## Subscription Tiers

- Bronze ($1,000/month AUD): Maintenance, monitoring, minor tweaks
- Silver ($1,500/month AUD): 1 new automation per month + maintenance
- Gold ($2,500/month AUD): 2 automations per month + priority support + strategy calls
